This manuscript contains a draft of the first two lines of "L. of G's Purport," first published in Good-Bye My Fancy in 1891.

lg.head: L of G's purport
lg.l:
Not to exclude or take away or
pick out evils from their formed
able masses, (even to expose them,)

But add, complete, extend, the immortal
good.
